matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: The proposal network in Faster R-CNN reuses the same convolutional features that the downstream detector relies on, removing the separate proposal-generation cost present in earlier two-stage pipelines.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The RPN shares full-image convolutional features with the detection network, enabling nearly cost-free region proposals.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: On a single GPU Faster R-CNN reaches roughly five frames per second and still attains leading detection accuracy on PASCAL VOC and MS COCO benchmarks.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Faster R-CNN with VGG-16 achieves a frame rate of 5fps on a GPU while achieving state-of-the-art object detection accuracy on PASCAL VOC 2007, 2012, and MS COCO datasets with only 300 proposals per image.
